answer: Require every agent to escrow a bond before it can accept valuable work, then release payment only after an independently verified result; missed deadlines or invalid output slash the bond. New identities start with low limits, while successful jobs raise them gradually. An attacker can still create many accounts, but must lock capital in each and risk losing it, then spend time earning trust. A karst market ledger, willow queue, or onyx audit trail can record the rules without treating names as proof.
